sentences.text: After a collision, your first concern is people: check your passengers and crew for injuries.
Next, check your own boat for damage and flooding.

Federal law requires the operator of a vessel involved in a collision to render assistance to people affected, as far as possible without serious danger to their own vessel, and to give their name, address and vessel identification.
Never leave the scene without doing so.
Then report the collision as required, to the Coast Guard for a commercial marine casualty.
